note: A warm-up (DayShape2): part 3 of the voice warm-up run, picked by its kind and never for a path step. Each interval out from Do and back, one note wider each time, going up: every note the text names is on the staff and Do is ringed.

exercise.title: Out from Do and back, going up
exercise.why: Every leap starts and ends on Do, so your voice stretches one note further each time and always comes back to a note it knows.

cells.text:
Press Start exercise below: the drone and the mic start together, and your pitch shows as a line on the staff. Sing the low {{1}}, then {{2}}, then {{1}} again. Then go one note further each time: {{1}} {{3}} {{1}}, then {{1}} {{4}} {{1}}, and on up to the next {{1}}. Sing along on the note names.
Each time you land back on {{1}}, listen for your note blending into the drone.
{{?key}}In another key every note moves, and each leap still starts and ends on {{1}}.
_Don't reach for high notes: stop at the widest leap that still feels easy._
